title: Womens Beauty Box Subscription
text: I gave it an overall 3-stars because while the products looked great, I never received a box for the last two months after initially subscribing. So, I can't review the products, because I don't know! Also, compared to other beauty boxes out there this one is a bit more expensive for less items. I canceled without ever  having received the product! I'll try another subscription service that's cheaper.
label: neutral
